SEARCH
Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.model.element

Class SearchRegionOnObject

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.model.element.SearchRegionOnObject
public class SearchRegionOnObject extends Object
Configuration for deriving search regions from another state object's match. This allows state objects to define their search areas dynamically based on the location of other objects, even from different states.
